role: On-device Apple Intelligence provider (Foundation Models, iOS 26+): availability check, prewarm, a process-wide LanguageModelSession cache with a token ledger, per-turn planning (Apple-specific instructions, relevance-ranked tools that fit the 4K window, compacted transcript, tool-output allowance), streaming with one trimmed retry on context overflow, error translation, plus AppleReplyTrimmer/AppleReplyRelay that end capped replies at a complete sentence.
types: SessionRequest: struct (private) — what a send asks of the cache
SessionLease: struct (private) — leased session + fresh flag + follow-up tool budget
SessionCache: actor (private) — single cached LanguageModelSession with signature/ledger
TurnPlan: struct (private) — instructions/tools/transcript/allowance for one attempt
FailedAfterOutput: struct Error (private) — stream failure after text was shown
AppleReplyTrimmer: enum — 150-word length rule and sentence-boundary trimming
AppleReplyRelay: struct — converts cumulative snapshots into sentence-at-a-time deltas

toplevel: All Foundation Models code is under #if canImport(FoundationModels) and @available(iOS 26, *); without it send() fails with unsupportedOS and isAvailable is false. id is a stored let .apple.

flags.text: One process-wide SessionCache serves every Apple send. AssistantViewModel.runAutoFactExtraction prefers Apple and runs detached after each chat reply with its own system prompt and a 1-message transcript; its lease fails canReuse (conversationLength 1 / different signature) and adopt() replaces the cached chat session, so with auto-extract on the chat's next Apple turn always starts a fresh session and re-sends the compacted transcript, defeating the cache.
